scope: One DT run per task matching cited rollout budgets. This is not a reproduction of the papers' algorithms, models or reported scores.

Webshop.differences: Author script uses webshop.use_small=True (1k products), human_goals=False, history length2, prompt cap4096 and response cap512. Candidate restores author history rendering and prompt cap4096; prior response cap1024 is retained. Qwen3.5-9B, total cap32768, minibatch4, gamma1, DT advantages and selected LoRA settings are required adaptations; the original model, minibatch64 and gamma.95 are not claimed. One run, not three-seed aggregate. Task-performance non-regression remains to be measured.

Sokoban.differences: Budget independently confirmed in author script20bd331. Original uses visual Qwen2.5-VL-3B,1024 prompt/512 response,15 steps. Candidate uses existing text Qwen3.5-9B and author text renderer, history2, prompt cap1024, response1024, total configured cap32768. The text modality/model and DT training settings remain explicit adaptations; no visual-paper score reproduction claim. Official one-box process rewards stay fixed.

AppWorld.differences: LOOP source gives nominal 240 rollouts and early-stops stragglers at >=90%; our fixed owner collects all 240. Official training example sets learning_max_seq_len=32000, truncates each API output to 3000 tokens and ends an individual episode on MaxSeqLenExceeded; these do not guarantee that all episodes finish within the cap. Current owner retains full API observations; the user approved ending the affected episode at the reserved 32768 context budget, retaining only existing official rewards, without introducing the API-output truncation. No LOOP filters, reward normalization, trained value model or replacement PPO are added. Existing VERL official success reward 10/0 stays fixed; LOOP used test-pass fractions. The original max response 1500, LoRA rank16, LR5e-5 and minibatch32 are not substituted. Dev evaluation uses existing owner 40-turn loop, versus paper evaluation 50. One run, not three-seed aggregate. Author verl-agent defaults to history2 and10000 characters; this run uses existing history_length=40 and a default-inert character-cap option set to null to preserve the user-approved full-history contract.
